environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 instances behind a public Application Load Balancer in us-east-1. The ALB has a public DNS name and accepts traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. Security group sg-0a1b2c3d allows inbound HTTPS from any source. The service uses Django 4.2 with DEBUG=False but the Django template engine has no sandboxing configured. IAM instance role has s3:GetObject on the application bucket. Any authenticated user (JWT-based auth via django-rest-framework-simplejwt) can reach the endpoint.
